working: Whole-history peak 200,000 (2025-02-14): the pre-history floor is 1 % of it, 2,000, whatever dates are chosen (§2 Yearly return).
Range 2025-03-15 (Saturday) .. 2025-06-30. The series shown: the stated days in it, first 2025-03-17, last 2025-06-30 (08-01 is past it).

Drawdown: flow-adjusted index over the days kept, 03-17 1.05, 04-15 0.945, 05-15 1.0395, 06-30 1.091475; peak from the first of them, 1.05 on 03-17; trough 0.945 on 04-15: 0.945 ÷ 1.05 − 1 = −0.1. (A peak from before the range, 200,000 on 02-14, would give 170,100 ÷ 200,000 − 1 = −0.1495; 08-01's fall is past the range.)
